Messages.Author: pittboo
Messages.Body:
If minion with superior Chimerstry plays Horrid Reality and get an Assult
Riffle and uses Dragon Breath Rounds is the guned burned or put back into
your library?
Thanks
Droz

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Burned.

Horrid Reality [DS] - Combat (chi) (2)
* If the weapon gained is not in play (burned by Destroy Equipment, e.g.)
by the end of combat, do not burn it (or do not shuffle it into your
library, if superior). [TOM 951212]
